definitionZh: CSS ID 选择器根据元素的 id 属性值匹配一个元素. 要选择元素,其id属性必须精确匹配选择器给出的值.
sourceDefinition: The CSS ID selector matches an element based on the value of the element's id attribute. In order for the element to be selected, its id attribute must match exactly the value given in the selector.
